Ops margin is 0.34 against a 0.63 target, with infra cost per unit at 2.00 and runway at 9 months. Renewal pressure is building around Clear Logistics Customer 10, Clear Logistics Customer 5, while support volume sits at 147 and execution quality matters more than usual.
